options.description: The velocity (in mm/s) to set the "stealthChop" threshold to. When set, "stealthChop" mode will be enabled if the stepper motor velocity is below this value. Note that the "sensorless homing" code may temporarily override this setting during homing operations. The default is 0, which disables "stealthChop" mode.

options.name: coolstep_threshold
options.description: The velocity (in mm/s) to set the TMC driver internal "CoolStep" threshold to. If set, the coolstep feature will be enabled when the stepper motor velocity is near or above this value. Important - if coolstep_threshold is set and "sensorless homing" is used, then one must ensure that the homing speed is above the coolstep threshold! The default is to not enable the coolstep feature.

options.name: high_velocity_threshold
options.description: The velocity (in mm/s) to set the TMC driver internal "high velocity" threshold (THIGH) to. This is typically used to disable the "CoolStep" feature at high speeds. The default is to not set a TMC "high velocity" threshold.

options.name: driver_START_SIN90
options.description: These fields control the Microstep Table registers directly. The optimal wave table is specific to each motor and might vary with current. An optimal configuration will have minimal print artifacts caused by non-linear stepper movement. The values specified above are the default values used by the driver. The value must be specified as a decimal integer (hex form is not supported). In order to compute the wave table fields, see the tmc2130 "Calculation Sheet" from the Trinamic website.

options.name: driver_FILT_ISENSE
options.description: Set the given register during the configuration of the TMC5160 chip. This may be used to set custom motor parameters. The defaults for each parameter are next to the parameter name in the above list.

options.name: diag1_pin
options.description: The micro-controller pin attached to one of the DIAG lines of the TMC5160 chip. Only a single diag pin should be specified. The pin is "active low" and is thus normally prefaced with "^!". Setting this creates a "tmc5160_stepper_x:virtual_endstop" virtual pin which may be used as the stepper's endstop_pin. Doing this enables "sensorless homing". (Be sure to also set driver_SGT to an appropriate sensitivity value.) The default is to not enable sensorless homing.

options.name: enable_pin
options.description: The pin corresponding to the AD5206 chip select line. This pin will be set to low at the start of SPI messages and raised to high after the message completes. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: spi_software_miso_pin
options.description: See the "common SPI settings" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: channel_6
options.description: The value to statically set the given AD5206 channel to. This is typically set to a number between 0.0 and 1.0 with 1.0 being the highest resistance and 0.0 being the lowest resistance. However, the range may be changed with the 'scale' parameter (see below). If a channel is not specified then it is left unconfigured.

options.name: scale
options.description: This parameter can be used to alter how the 'channel_x' parameters are interpreted. If provided, then the 'channel_x' parameters should be between 0.0 and 'scale'. This may be useful when the AD5206 is used to set stepper voltage references. The 'scale' can be set to the equivalent stepper amperage if the AD5206 were at its highest resistance, and then the 'channel_x' parameters can be specified using the desired amperage value for the stepper. The default is to not scale the 'channel_x' parameters.

options.name: i2c_address
options.description: The i2c address that the chip is using on the i2c bus. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: i2c_speed
options.description: See the "common I2C settings" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: wiper_3
options.description: The value to statically set the given MCP4451 "wiper" to. This is typically set to a number between 0.0 and 1.0 with 1.0 being the highest resistance and 0.0 being the lowest resistance. However, the range may be changed with the 'scale' parameter (see below). If a wiper is not specified then it is left unconfigured.

options.name: scale
options.description: This parameter can be used to alter how the 'wiper_x' parameters are interpreted. If provided, then the 'wiper_x' parameters should be between 0.0 and 'scale'. This may be useful when the MCP4451 is used to set stepper voltage references. The 'scale' can be set to the equivalent stepper amperage if the MCP4451 were at its highest resistance, and then the 'wiper_x' parameters can be specified using the desired amperage value for the stepper. The default is to not scale the 'wiper_x' parameters.

options.name: i2c_address
options.description: The i2c address that the chip is using on the i2c bus. The default is 96.

options.name: i2c_speed
options.description: See the "common I2C settings" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: channel_d
options.description: The value to statically set the given MCP4728 channel to. This is typically set to a number between 0.0 and 1.0 with 1.0 being the highest voltage (2.048V) and 0.0 being the lowest voltage. However, the range may be changed with the 'scale' parameter (see below). If a channel is not specified then it is left unconfigured.

options.name: scale
options.description: This parameter can be used to alter how the 'channel_x' parameters are interpreted. If provided, then the 'channel_x' parameters should be between 0.0 and 'scale'. This may be useful when the MCP4728 is used to set stepper voltage references. The 'scale' can be set to the equivalent stepper amperage if the MCP4728 were at its highest voltage (2.048V), and then the 'channel_x' parameters can be specified using the desired amperage value for the stepper. The default is to not scale the 'channel_x' parameters.

options.name: i2c_address
options.description: The i2c address that the chip is using on the i2c bus. The default is 47.

options.name: i2c_speed
options.description: See the "common I2C settings" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: wiper
options.description: The value to statically set the given MCP4018 "wiper" to. This is typically set to a number between 0.0 and 1.0 with 1.0 being the highest resistance and 0.0 being the lowest resistance. However, the range may be changed with the 'scale' parameter (see below). This parameter must be provided.

options.name: scale
options.description: This parameter can be used to alter how the 'wiper' parameter is interpreted. If provided, then the 'wiper' parameter should be between 0.0 and 'scale'. This may be useful when the MCP4018 is used to set stepper voltage references. The 'scale' can be set to the equivalent stepper amperage if the MCP4018 is at its highest resistance, and then the 'wiper' parameter can be specified using the desired amperage value for the stepper. The default is to not scale the 'wiper' parameter.

options.name: lcd_type
options.description: The type of LCD chip in use. This may be "hd44780", "hd44780_spi", "aip31068_spi", "st7920", "emulated_st7920", "uc1701", "ssd1306", or "sh1106". See the display sections below for information on each type and additional parameters they provide. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: display_group
options.description: The name of the display_data group to show on the display. This controls the content of the screen (see the "display_data" section for more information). The default is _default_20x4 for hd44780 or aip31068_spi displays and _default_16x4 for other displays.

options.name: menu_timeout
options.description: Timeout for menu. Being inactive this amount of seconds will trigger menu exit or return to root menu when having autorun enabled. The default is 0 seconds (disabled)

options.name: menu_root
options.description: Name of the main menu section to show when clicking the encoder on the home screen. The defaults is __main, and this shows the the default menus as defined in klippy/extras/display/menu.cfg

options.name: menu_reverse_navigation
options.description: When enabled it will reverse up and down directions for list navigation. The default is False. This parameter is optional.

options.name: encoder_pins
options.description: The pins connected to encoder. 2 pins must be provided when using encoder. This parameter must be provided when using menu.

options.name: encoder_steps_per_detent
options.description: How many steps the encoder emits per detent ("click"). If the encoder takes two detents to move between entries or moves two entries from one detent, try changing this. Allowed values are 2 (half-stepping) or 4 (full-stepping). The default is 4.

options.name: click_pin
options.description: The pin connected to 'enter' button or encoder 'click'. This parameter must be provided when using menu. The presence of an 'analog_range_click_pin' config parameter turns this parameter from digital to analog.

options.name: back_pin
options.description: The pin connected to 'back' button. This parameter is optional, menu can be used without it. The presence of an 'analog_range_back_pin' config parameter turns this parameter from digital to analog.

options.name: up_pin
options.description: The pin connected to 'up' button. This parameter must be provided when using menu without encoder. The presence of an 'analog_range_up_pin' config parameter turns this parameter from digital to analog.

options.name: down_pin
options.description: The pin connected to 'down' button. This parameter must be provided when using menu without encoder. The presence of an 'analog_range_down_pin' config parameter turns this parameter from digital to analog.

options.name: kill_pin
options.description: The pin connected to 'kill' button. This button will call emergency stop. The presence of an 'analog_range_kill_pin' config parameter turns this parameter from digital to analog.

options.name: analog_pullup_resistor
options.description: The resistance (in ohms) of the pullup attached to the analog button. The default is 4700 ohms.

options.name: analog_range_click_pin
options.description: The resistance range for a 'enter' button. Range minimum and maximum comma-separated values must be provided when using analog button.

options.name: analog_range_back_pin
options.description: The resistance range for a 'back' button. Range minimum and maximum comma-separated values must be provided when using analog button.

options.name: analog_range_up_pin
options.description: The resistance range for a 'up' button. Range minimum and maximum comma-separated values must be provided when using analog button.

options.name: analog_range_down_pin
options.description: The resistance range for a 'down' button. Range minimum and maximum comma-separated values must be provided when using analog button.

options.name: analog_range_kill_pin
options.description: The resistance range for a 'kill' button. Range minimum and maximum comma-separated values must be provided when using analog button.

options.name: d7_pin
options.description: The pins connected to an hd44780 type lcd. These parameters must be provided.

options.name: hd44780_protocol_init
options.description: Perform 8-bit/4-bit protocol initialization on an hd44780 display. This is necessary on real hd44780 devices. However, one may need to disable this on some "clone" devices. The default is True.

options.name: line_length
options.description: Set the number of characters per line for an hd44780 type lcd. Possible values are 20 (default) and 16. The number of lines is fixed to 4.

options.name: spi_software_miso_pin
options.description: The pins connected to the shift register controlling the display. The spi_software_miso_pin needs to be set to an unused pin of the printer mainboard as the shift register does not have a MISO pin, but the software spi implementation requires this pin to be configured.

options.name: sid_pin
options.description: The pins connected to an st7920 type lcd. These parameters must be provided.

options.name: a0_pin
options.description: The pins connected to a uc1701 type lcd. These parameters must be provided.

options.name: rst_pin
options.description: The pin connected to the "rst" pin on the lcd. If it is not specified then the hardware must have a pull-up on the corresponding lcd line.

options.name: contrast
options.description: The contrast to set. The value may range from 0 to 63 and the default is 40.

options.name: i2c_speed
options.description: Optional parameters available for displays connected via an i2c bus. See the "common I2C settings" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: reset_pin
options.description: A reset pin may be specified on the display. If it is not specified then the hardware must have a pull-up on the corresponding lcd line.

options.name: vcomh
options.description: Set the Vcomh value on the display. This value is associated with a "smearing" effect on some OLED displays. The value may range from 0 to 63. Default is 0.

options.name: invert
options.description: TRUE inverts the pixels on certain OLED displays.  The default is False.

options.name: x_offset
options.description: Set the horizontal offset value on SH1106 displays. The default is 0.

options.name: position
options.description: Comma separated row and column of the display position that should be used to display the information. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: text
options.description: The text to show at the given position. This field is evaluated using command templates (see docs/Command_Templates.md). This parameter must be provided.

options.name: text
options.description: The text to return when the this template is rendered. This field is evaluated using command templates (see docs/Command_Templates.md). This parameter must be provided.

options.name: data
options.description: The display data, stored as 16 lines consisting of 16 bits (1 per pixel) where '.' is a blank pixel and '*' is an on pixel (e.g., "****************" to display a solid horizontal line). Alternatively, one can use '0' for a blank pixel and '1' for an on pixel. Put each display line into a separate config line. The glyph must consist of exactly 16 lines with 16 bits each. This parameter is optional.

options.name: hd44780_data
options.description: Glyph to use on 20x4 hd44780 displays. The glyph must consist of exactly 8 lines with 5 bits each. This parameter is optional.

options.name: hd44780_slot
options.description: The hd44780 hardware index (0..7) to store the glyph at. If multiple distinct images use the same slot then make sure to only use one of those images in any given screen. This parameter is required if hd44780_data is specified.

options.name: type
options.description: Permanently disabled menu element, only required attribute is 'type'. Allows you to easily disable/hide existing menu items. [menu some_name]

options.name: name
options.description: Name of menu item - evaluated as a template.

options.name: enable
options.description: Template that evaluates to True or False.

options.name: index
options.description: Position where an item needs to be inserted in list. By default the item is added at the end. [menu some_list]

options.name: gcode
options.description: Script to run on button click or long click. Evaluated as a template. [menu some_list some_input]

options.name: input
options.description: Initial value to use when editing - evaluated as a template. Result must be float.

options.name: input_min
options.description: Minimum value of range - evaluated as a template. Default -99999.

options.name: input_max
options.description: Maximum value of range - evaluated as a template. Default 99999.

options.name: input_step
options.description: Editing step - Must be a positive integer or float value. It has internal fast rate step. When "(input_max - input_min) / input_step > 100" then fast rate step is 10 * input_step else fast rate step is same input_step.

options.name: realtime
options.description: This attribute accepts static boolean value. When enabled then gcode script is run after each value change. The default is False.

options.name: pause_on_runout
options.description: When set to True, a PAUSE will execute immediately after a runout is detected. Note that if pause_on_runout is False and the runout_gcode is omitted then runout detection is disabled. Default is True.

options.name: runout_gcode
options.description: A list of G-Code commands to execute after a filament runout is detected. See docs/Command_Templates.md for G-Code format. If pause_on_runout is set to True this G-Code will run after the PAUSE is complete. The default is not to run any G-Code commands.

options.name: insert_gcode
options.description: A list of G-Code commands to execute after a filament insert is detected. See docs/Command_Templates.md for G-Code format. The default is not to run any G-Code commands, which disables insert detection.

options.name: event_delay
options.description: The minimum amount of time in seconds to delay between events. Events triggered during this time period will be silently ignored. The default is 3 seconds.

options.name: pause_delay
options.description: The amount of time to delay, in seconds, between the pause command dispatch and execution of the runout_gcode. It may be useful to increase this delay if OctoPrint exhibits strange pause behavior. Default is 0.5 seconds.

options.name: debounce_delay
options.description: A period of time in seconds to debounce events prior to running the switch gcode. The switch must he held in a single state for at least this long to activate. If the switch is toggled on/off during this delay, the event is ignored. Default is 0.

options.name: switch_pin
options.description: The pin on which the switch is connected. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: detection_length
options.description: The minimum length of filament pulled through the sensor to trigger a state change on the switch_pin Default is 7 mm.

options.name: extruder
options.description: The name of the extruder or extruder_stepper section this sensor is associated with. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: pause_delay
options.description: See the "filament_switch_sensor" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: default_nominal_filament_diameter
options.description: Maximum allowed filament diameter difference as mm.

options.name: max_difference
options.description: The distance from sensor to the melting chamber as mm.

options.name: adc2
options.description: Analog input pins connected to the sensor. These parameters must be provided.

options.name: cal_dia2
options.description: The calibration values (in mm) for the sensors. The default is 1.50 for cal_dia1 and 2.00 for cal_dia2.

options.name: raw_dia2
options.description: The raw calibration values for the sensors. The values must be different. The default is 9500 for raw_dia1 and 10500 for raw_dia2.

options.name: default_nominal_filament_diameter
options.description: The nominal filament diameter. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: max_difference
options.description: Maximum allowed filament diameter difference in millimeters (mm). If difference between nominal filament diameter and sensor output is more than +- max_difference, extrusion multiplier is set back to 100%. Must be less than default_nominal_filament_diameter. The default is 0.200.

options.name: measurement_delay
options.description: The distance from sensor to the melting chamber/hot-end in millimeters (mm). The filament between the sensor and the hot-end will be treated as the default_nominal_filament_diameter. Host module works with FIFO logic. It keeps each sensor value and position in an array and POP them back in correct position. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: enable
options.description: Sensor enabled or disabled after power on. The default is to disable.

options.name: enable_flow_compensation
options.description: Flow compensation enabled or disabled. If set to False, the sensor will not modify the extrusion multiplier and will only trigger runout events. The default is True.

options.name: measurement_interval
options.description: The approximate distance (in mm) between sensor readings. The default is 10mm.

options.name: logging
options.description: Out diameter to terminal and klipper.log can be turn on|of by command.

options.name: min_diameter
options.description: Minimal diameter for trigger virtual filament_switch_sensor.

options.name: max_diameter
options.description: Maximum diameter for triggering virtual filament_switch_sensor. The default is default_nominal_filament_diameter + max_difference.

options.name: use_current_dia_while_delay
options.description: Use the current diameter instead of the nominal diameter while the measurement delay has not run through.

options.name: pause_delay
options.description: See the "filament_switch_sensor" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: sensor_type
options.description: This must be one of the supported sensor types, see below.

options.name: counts_per_gram
options.description: The floating point number of sensor counts that indicates 1 gram of force. This value is calculated by the LOAD_CELL_CALIBRATE command.

options.name: reference_tare_counts
options.description: The integer tare value, in raw sensor counts, taken when LOAD_CELL_CALIBRATE is run. This is the default tare value when klipper starts up.

options.name: sensor_orientation
options.description: Change the sensor's orientation. Can be either 'normal' or 'inverted'. The default is 'normal'. Use 'inverted' if the sensor reports a decreasing force value when placed under load.

options.name: sclk_pin
options.description: The pin connected to the HX711 clock line. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: dout_pin
options.description: The pin connected to the HX711 data output line. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: gain
options.description: Valid values for gain are: A-128, A-64, B-32. The default is A-128. 'A' denotes the input channel and the number denotes the gain. Only the 3 listed combinations are supported by the chip. Note that changing the gain setting also selects the channel being read.

options.name: sample_rate
options.description: Valid values for sample_rate are 80 or 10. The default value is 80. This must match the wiring of the chip. The sample rate cannot be changed in software.

options.name: cs_pin
options.description: The pin connected to the ADS1220 chip select line. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: spi_speed
options.description: This chip supports 2 speeds: 256000 or 512000. The faster speed is only enabled when one of the Turbo sample rates is used. The correct spi_speed is selected based on the sample rate.

options.name: spi_software_miso_pin
options.description: See the "common SPI settings" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: data_ready_pin
options.description: Pin connected to the ADS1220 data ready line. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: pga_bypass
options.description: Disable the internal Programmable Gain Amplifier. If True the PGA will be disabled for gains 1, 2, and 4. The PGA is always enabled for gain settings 8 to 128, regardless of the pga_bypass setting. If AVSS is used as an input pga_bypass is forced to True. The default is False.

options.name: input_mux
options.description: Input multiplexer configuration, select a pair of pins to use. The first pin is the positive, AINP, and the second pin is the negative, AINN. Valid values are: 'AIN0_AIN1', 'AIN0_AIN2', 'AIN0_AIN3', 'AIN1_AIN2', 'AIN1_AIN3', 'AIN2_AIN3', 'AIN1_AIN0', 'AIN3_AIN2', 'AIN0_AVSS', 'AIN1_AVSS', 'AIN2_AVSS' and 'AIN3_AVSS'. If AVSS is used the PGA is bypassed and the pga_bypass setting will be forced to True. The default is AIN0_AIN1.

options.name: vref
options.description: The selected voltage reference. Valid values are: 'internal', 'REF0', 'REF1' and 'analog_supply'. Default is 'internal'.

options.name: adc_channel
options.description: The ADC channel to read. For the ADS131M02, valid values are 0 and 1. For the ADS131M04, valid values are 0, 1, 2, and 3. The default is 0.

options.name: clock_freq
options.description: The external clock frequency (fCLKIN) in Hz supplied to the CLKIN pin. The valid range is 300000 to 8400000. The nominal clock frequency for the ADS131M0x is 8192000 Hz; it is recommended to use a clock source near this frequency. Either clock_freq or pwm_clock must be provided.

options.name: pwm_clock
options.description: Reference to a [static_pwm_clock] section that generates the clock signal for the CLKIN pin. The frequency of this clock is used as fCLKIN. Either clock_freq or pwm_clock must be provided.

options.name: enable_global_chop
options.description: Enable global-chop mode to reduce internal system offset errors by averaging two conversions with opposite input polarities. The default is False.

options.name: global_chop_delay
options.description: The global-chop delay in modulator clock periods, only used when enable_global_chop is True. Higher values allow more settling time between input swaps. Valid values are all powers of 2 from 2 to 65536. The default is 16.

options.name: sensor_type
options.description: This must be one of the supported bulk ADC sensor types and support load cell endstops on the mcu.

options.name: sensor_orientation
options.description: These parameters must be configured before the probe will operate. See the [load_cell] section for further details.

options.name: force_safety_limit
options.description: The safe limit for probing force relative to the reference_tare_counts on the load_cell. The default is +/-2Kg.

options.name: trigger_force
options.description: The force that the probe will trigger at. 75g is the default.

options.name: drift_filter_cutoff_frequency
options.description: Enable optional continuous taring while homing & probing to reject drift. The value is a frequency, in Hz, below which drift will be ignored. This option requires the SciPy library. Default: None

options.name: drift_filter_delay
options.description: The delay, or 'order', of the drift filter. This controls the number of samples required to make a trigger detection. Can be 1 or 2, the default is 2.

options.name: buzz_filter_cutoff_frequency
options.description: The value is a frequency, in Hz, above which high frequency noise in the load cell will be igfiltered outnored. This option requires the SciPy library. Default: None

options.name: buzz_filter_delay
options.description: The delay, or 'order', of the buzz filter. This controls the number of samples required to make a trigger detection. Can be 1 or 2, the default is 2.

options.name: notch_filter_frequencies
options.description: 1 or 2 frequencies, in Hz, to filter out of the load cell data. This is intended to reject power line noise. This option requires the SciPy library.  Default: None

options.name: notch_filter_quality
options.description: Controls how narrow the range of frequencies are that the notch filter removes. Larger numbers produce a narrower filter. Minimum value is 0.5 and maximum is 3.0. Default: 2.0

options.name: tare_time
options.description: The rime in seconds used for taring the load_cell before each probe. The default value is: 4 / 60 = 0.066. This collects samples from 4 cycles of 60Hz mains power to cancel power line noise.

options.name: deactivate_gcode
options.description: See the "[probe]" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: i2c_address
options.description: I2C address used by this expander. Depending on the hardware jumpers this is one out of the following addresses: 62 63 112 113. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: i2c_speed
options.description: See the "common I2C settings" section for a description of the above parameters.

options.name: sercom
options.description: The name of the sercom bus to configure in the micro-controller. Available names are "sercom0", "sercom1", etc.. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: tx_pin
options.description: MOSI pin for SPI communication, or SDA (data) pin for I2C communication. The pin must have a valid pinmux configuration for the given SERCOM peripheral. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: rx_pin
options.description: MISO pin for SPI communication. This pin is not used for I2C communication (I2C uses tx_pin for both sending and receiving). The pin must have a valid pinmux configuration for the given SERCOM peripheral. This parameter is optional.

options.name: clk_pin
options.description: CLK pin for SPI communication, or SCL (clock) pin for I2C communication. The pin must have a valid pinmux configuration for the given SERCOM peripheral. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: vref_pin
options.description: The ADC pin to use for VREF monitoring. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: vssa_pin
options.description: The ADC pin to use for VSSA monitoring. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: smooth_time
options.description: A time value (in seconds) over which the vref and vssa measurements will be smoothed to reduce the impact of measurement noise. The default is 2 seconds.

options.name: pga
options.description: Default value is 4.096V. The maximum voltage range used for the input. This scales all values read from the ADC. Options are: 6.144V, 4.096V, 2.048V, 1.024V, 0.512V, 0.256V

options.name: adc_voltage
options.description: The supply voltage for the device. This allows additional software scaling for all values read from the ADC.

options.name: address_pin
options.description: Default value is GND.  There can be up to four addressed devices depending upon wiring of the device. Check the datasheet for details. The i2c_address can be specified directly instead of using the address_pin.

options.name: sensor_type
options.description: Can be any thermistor or adc_temperature.

options.name: sensor_pin
options.description: A combination of the name of the ads1x1x chip and the pin. Possible pin values are AIN0, AIN1, AIN2 and AIN3 for single ended lines and DIFF01, DIFF03, DIFF13 and DIFF23 for differential between their corresponding lines. For example DIFF03 measures the differential between line 0 and 3. Only specific combinations for the differentials are allowed.

options.name: revision
options.description: The replicape hardware revision. Currently only revision "B3" is supported. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: enable_pin
options.description: The replicape global enable pin. The default is !gpio0_20 (aka P9_41).

options.name: host_mcu
options.description: The name of the mcu config section that communicates with the Klipper "linux process" mcu instance. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: standstill_power_down
options.description: This parameter controls the CFG6_ENN line on all stepper motors. True sets the enable lines to "open". The default is False.

options.name: stepper_h_microstep_mode
options.description: This parameter controls the CFG1 and CFG2 pins of the given stepper motor driver. Available options are: disable, 1, 2, spread2, 4, 16, spread4, spread16, stealth4, and stealth16. The default is disable.

options.name: stepper_h_current
options.description: The configured maximum current (in Amps) of the stepper motor driver. This parameter must be provided if the stepper is not in a disable mode.

options.name: stepper_h_chopper_off_time_high
options.description: This parameter controls the CFG0 pin of the stepper motor driver (True sets CFG0 high, False sets it low). The default is False.

options.name: stepper_h_chopper_hysteresis_high
options.description: This parameter controls the CFG4 pin of the stepper motor driver (True sets CFG4 high, False sets it low). The default is False.

options.name: stepper_h_chopper_blank_time_high
options.description: This parameter controls the CFG5 pin of the stepper motor driver (True sets CFG5 high, False sets it low). The default is True.

options.name: serial
options.description: The serial port to connect to the Palette 2.

options.name: baud
options.description: The baud rate to use. The default is 115200.

options.name: feedrate_splice
options.description: The feedrate to use when splicing, default is 0.8

options.name: feedrate_normal
options.description: The feedrate to use after splicing, default is 1.0

options.name: auto_load_speed
options.description: Extrude feedrate when autoloading, default is 2 (mm/s)

options.name: auto_cancel_variation
options.description: Auto cancel print when ping variation is above this threshold

options.name: sensor_type
options.description: The type of the magnetic hall sensor chip. Available choices are "a1333", "as5047d", "mt6816", "mt6826s", and "tle5012b". This parameter must be specified.

options.name: sample_period
options.description: The query period (in seconds) to use during measurements. The default is 0.000400 (which is 2500 samples per second).

options.name: stepper
options.description: The name of the stepper that the angle sensor is attached to (eg, "stepper_x"). Setting this value enables an angle calibration tool. To use this feature, the Python "numpy" package must be installed. The default is to not enable angle calibration for the angle sensor.

options.name: cs_pin
options.description: The SPI enable pin for the sensor. This parameter must be provided.

options.name: spi_software_miso_pin
options.description: See the "common SPI settings" section for a description of the above parameters.
